Welcome to the 4th edition of Weekly Tidbits, where we pick interesting stories that often don’t make it into a full Daily Brief and add some context around them.
This week, we cover 12 stories across global markets, the Indian economy, key industries and companies.
From Saudi Arabia’s oil pipeline attack and rising US borrowing costs to China’s antitrust investigations, we look at the developments shaping global markets. In India, we cover Bangladesh buying wheat again, the recovery in GST collections and a proposed ₹20,000 crore AI fund.
